steps.say: Click once on the Documents folder.
steps.detail: One click selects it. It turns light blue.
steps.hint: Look for the glowing ring on the left side of the screen.

steps.say: Now double-click it: click twice, very quickly.
steps.hint: Click the same folder two times fast.

steps.say: Click the X in the top-right corner to close the window.
steps.detail: The X always closes a window.

steps.say: Right-click on an empty part of the desktop.
steps.detail: Press the right-hand button on your mouse, or tap the bottom-right of your touchpad.
steps.hint: Anywhere on the blue background will work.

steps.say: Click Refresh to close the menu.
steps.detail: Right-click shows extra choices. Refresh is safe: nothing will break.
